**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2024/01/05 (Fri) 05:47  
[EVENT] User is planning to make a stir-fry for dinner tonight.  
[EVENT] User did an online grocery order from Instacart and had it delivered to their doorstep.  
[FACT] User spent around $60 on their grocery order.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for suggestions for a good stir-fry sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several stir-fry sauce options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Soy sauce-based sauce: made with soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, and chili flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Oyster sauce-based sauce: similar to soy sauce-based but richer with oyster sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sesame oil and soy sauce: a simple combination with a nutty aroma.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Honey and hoisin sauce: sweet and savory, with rice vinegar and soy sauce for balance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Kung Pao sauce: spicy and savory with soy sauce, vinegar, hoisin sauce, and hot peppers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Peanut sauce: creamy and nutty with peanut butter, soy sauce, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that store-bought stir-fry sauces are also available.  
[FACT] User is thinking of using chicken breasts for the stir-fry.  
[EVENT] User bought chicken breasts last Saturday when grocery shopping.  
[FACT] User plans to use frozen veggies in their stir-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended stir-fry sauces that would complement chicken and frozen veggies:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Soy sauce-based sauce with garlic and ginger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hoisin sauce with rice vinegar and sesame oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sweet and sour sauce.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering using frozen peas and carrots in their stir-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested that sweet and sour sauce might not be the best match for peas and carrots due to potential sweetness clash.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended the soy sauce-based sauce or hoisin sauce-based sauce instead.  
[PREFERENCE] User decided to try the soy sauce-based sauce with garlic and ginger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a rough estimate of ingredients for the soy sauce-based sauce:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2-3 cloves of garlic, minced
